title: Cohort chunk delivery
description: Delivery of one cohort chunk through implementation, joint read-only verification, and verdict-routed remediation. With --with-design, design review and design QA join verification; release preparation remains on the integrated cohort.

evidence_workers.scope: Independently review the implemented UI against the authoritative design specification, HTML mocks, tokens, states, and design acceptance criteria. Record concrete findings for the verifier and do not review unrelated architecture.

Verify the implemented UI behavior against the authoritative design specification, HTML mocks, and design acceptance criteria. Record reproducible design QA evidence for the verifier and route defects through the existing verdict.
